wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on July 24, 2025 under Executive Order 13382, program tag NPWMD, for support to Korea Sobaeksu Trading Corporation

details.label: Linked to
details.value: Korea Sobaeksu Trading Corporation, a.k.a. Sobaeksu United Corporation

wanted_details.caution: Jo Kyong Hun is a North Korea-based Sobaeksu IT team leader who has worked with Kim Se Un on cryptocurrency and other financial issues related to revenue generation for IT projects. Korea Sobaeksu Trading Company is a DPRK-based trading company that operates as a front company for the U.S.-designated Munitions Industry Department, which has previously utilized Sobaeksu to send teams of IT workers overseas, including to Vietnam, in order to generate revenue.

sources.title: Recent Actions, July 24, 2025: North Korea Designations (Korea Sobaeksu Trading Corporation)
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC)

sources.title: Treasury Sanctions Clandestine IT Worker Network Funding the DPRK's Weapons Programs

disclaimer: The confidence level of 'confirmed' reflects that this individual is named on OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals list; a sanctions designation is an administrative action by the Treasury and not a criminal charge, and nothing here states that any court has found anything.
